gold_decisions.identity_explanation: Both identify the false positive lower bound for the interface term b_Γ, demonstrate failure using zero free-fluid velocity and a nonzero normal jump, and identify the required negative Young estimate and penalty absorption.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The interface term is sign-indefinite and cannot satisfy the asserted positive jump coercivity bound; coercivity requires a negative trace/Young estimate absorbed by a sufficiently large penalty.

gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-014 recognizes that the stated temporal solution regularity exceeds the declared time-dependent data class, supplies the same type of unbounded-load contradiction, and proposes adding adequate temporal regularity including constraint data.
